claim: The verifier is a single stdlib-only source with zero imports and no I/O; it defines verify(witness), which raises AssertionError on any failed check and returns cleanly only if every odd n with 3 <= n <= 199 has a decomposition n = k + 2^l with k squarefree (k=1 allowed, Mathlib convention) and l in 0..7. Clean return certifies this finite range fragment of L1; the all-odd-n>1 extension remains open.
law: Wang 7.2: an exact finite object plus a proved reduction is a CERTIFICATE. The reduction is the `claim` and is a human's to audit; the object and the verifier run are the machine's part.
